name: whatsapp-bot
description: Bot pengingat deadline tugas via WhatsApp (Baileys)

scripts.reset: node -e "const {createClient}=require('@supabase/supabase-js');createClient(process.env.SUPABASE_URL,process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY||process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY).from('wa_sessions').delete().eq('session_id','main').then(()=>console.log('Sesi dihapus dari Supabase. Jalankan npm start lalu scan QR.'))"
